newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Finmeccanica sells Alfa to Fiat.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Finmeccanica sells Alfa to Fiat.

text.p: Italian state engineering group Finmeccanica said on Friday it had sold its 77.5 percent controlling stake in aeroplane manufacturing unit Alfa Romeo Avio to Fiat Avio for around 200 billion lire.
Fiat Avio is a division of carmaker Fiat.
Finmeccanica said that the sale, effective December 27, 1996, would reduce Finmeccanica's consolidated invested capital by some 380 billion lire.
Alfa Romeo Avio has sales of some 300 billion and a 1,500-strong staff. It supplies both the military and civilian sectors and is involved in a number of international projects.
